dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: The preliminary U.S. intelligence assessment of greater Iranian weapon interest remains uncorroborated by a new technical step. No Iranian order, breakout-hardware movement, atomic detonation, NPT withdrawal, or inspector-status change was verified. Raw 49; Iran-war coupling +7 => 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: ABC/wires report the first night without a new U.S. strike announcement after 13 consecutive nights while Washington says contacts are serious but threatens heavier attacks if they fail. Energy-route pressure widened through the Saudi-Houthi exchange. No formal Hormuz closure order, mine deployment, or literal zero-traffic condition surfaced. Raw 100; capped at 100 after coupling

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Washington meetings remain the main diplomatic channel. No fresh Hezbollah strategic attack, mass-casualty event, or collapse of Israel-Lebanon contacts surfaced in the rolling review. Raw 81; Iran coupling +10 => 91

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified Turkish combat entry, new force movement toward Iran, official doctrine shift, or long-range launch surfaced in the rolling 24-hour review. Raw/coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh Line of Control exchange, Indian force movement, or India-Pakistan strike was verified; newly indexed material was retrospective. Raw/coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Tank district bombing and Taliban rebuttal to Pakistani accusations remain the main items. No fresh Pakistan-Afghanistan state-on-state border strike, crossing closure, or sustained interstate clash was verified. Raw/coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Russian attacks killed three people in Sumy region while fighting continued elsewhere. No new nuclear-use preparation or direct NATO entry was verified; the already active war lane remains near ceiling. Raw/coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania shot down a second drone in national airspace in two days. Prosecutors identified Friday's drone as Russian; Saturday's origin remains under analysis, though Romania says its pattern matches prior Russian flights. Repetition by a NATO member's F-16 raises the lane without implying treaty consultation. Raw 47 => 51; Russia-Ukraine coupling +10 => 61

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new Taiwan quarantine, blockade declaration, amphibious mobilization, or military clash surfaced; current reporting remained preparedness and policy material. Raw 24; North Korea coupling +4 => 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: One specialist report, citing an OSINT account and anonymous Ukrainian intelligence-linked sources, says KN-23 shipments to Russia resumed. No fresh DPRK launch, atomic detonation, or major Korean Peninsula force movement surfaced. Raw/coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN's July 24 El Obeid reporting and continuing Darfur danger remain the latest reliable thresholds. No newer strategic advance around El Obeid, el-Fasher, or Port Sudan surfaced. Raw/coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters and Al Jazeera report dozens detained, roughly 70 Tal homes raided, movement curtailed, and an extensive Israeli operation after four Palestinians and two Israeli soldiers were killed. The confirmed expansion raises the near-ceiling lane by one point. Raw/coupled 95 => 96

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: New regional reporting discussed Burhan-Museveni contacts and South Sudan's election risk, but no fresh military clash, verified large force movement, or Abyei security shift surfaced. Raw/coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: The July 24 review's renewed M23/Wazalendo clashes and documented reinforcement remain the latest threshold. No post-06Z independent confirmation of the claimed mass recruitment or a new strategic capture surfaced. Raw/coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters verified smoke from the direction of Jizan's Aramco refinery, and Greek sources said a deployed Patriot battery intercepted two projectiles aimed at Yanbu refineries; Saudi authorities have not confirmed the extent of Jizan damage. The verified attempted energy-site attacks and widening exchange raise the lane four points. Raw/coupled 76 => 80

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Bellingcat's geolocation of two Shahed-type attacks and likely Russian support remains the latest threshold. No post-06Z confirmation of manufacturer/operator identity, new casualty toll, or strategic JNIM seizure surfaced. Raw/coupled 39

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: The July 24 Scarborough water-cannon encounter was reviewed as the already counted third faceoff of the week, not a distinct fourth event. No casualty, vessel loss, or treaty consultation surfaced. Raw/coupled 27

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reports continue to place M/T Asana under pirate control. No rescue, new hijacking, casualty, or naval engagement was verified; the EU NAVFOR newsroom path checked in this run returned 404. Raw/coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: Narathiwat's expanded security posture, search activity, and Malaysia-border fencing plan remain active. No new attack, province expansion, or confirmed cross-border spillover surfaced. Raw/coupled 25

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: A new fact-check rejected a circulating video as evidence of an Iranian attack on the Abdali crossing. No new Kuwait-Iraq territorial incursion or distinct border strike was verified. Raw/coupled 21
